newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Marcus Wallenberg takes key Investor post.
newsitem.headline: Marcus Wallenberg takes key Investor post.

text.p: Marcus Wallenberg has been appointed deputy chief executive and chief financial officer of Swedish investment company Investor AB, the company said in a statement.
Investor is the main investment vehicle of Sweden's powerful Wallenberg family.

Marcus's cousin Jakob has been named as the next managing director of major high street bank S-E-Banken as the family prepares for the retirement of Peter Wallenburg, the head of the family, who is easing his hold on the family business. -- Simon Haydon, Stockholm newsroom +46-8-700-1004 .
